title: Change lanes / alternate entries and exits
subtitle: Different starting evidence creates different obligations. A fix, a refactor, a docs edit and an experiment do not share identical ceremony.

nodes.title: /debug
nodes.body:
Diagnosis-only or one internal
prerequisite from an authorized fix
No code modification

nodes.title: debug / evidence-led investigation
nodes.body:
Cited symptom → real discriminators
Current source/runtime applicability
Exactly one supported disposition

nodes.title: /spike
nodes.body: Bounded unknown + timebox

nodes.title: Disposable spike/<slug>
nodes.body:
Explore the question in isolation
Exemption cannot land production work
Never merges or opens a PR

nodes.title: Findings note
nodes.body:
What was learned; uncertainty left
No requirement to build anything

nodes.title: /feature / new production path
nodes.body:
A separate approved specification
Experiment is evidence, not approval

nodes.title: /fix
nodes.body:
Observed ≠ expected behavior
Confirmed defect; cited evidence
nodes.detail: One bounded internal diagnostic return is permitted if required, without public fix/debug recursion. Before the author acts, select and deliver current context; independently revalidate a retained handoff and caller authority.

nodes.title: Causal evidence → target RED
nodes.body:
Cited cause + named regression
Observed target RED for the right reason
No feature spec or unrelated red

nodes.title: Complete tdd
nodes.body:
Obligations → red → green
Verify obligations → coverage → lint
Fresh local proof, not self-report

nodes.title: Verified correction
nodes.body:
Scoped code + regression + evidence
Commit only when authorized

nodes.title: /refactor
nodes.body:
Named restructure
Behavior must stay the same

nodes.title: Parity-coverage proof
nodes.body:
Unchanged pre-existing tests
Coverage backfill / new seams → TDD
No parity proof, no restructure

nodes.title: refactor / bounded change
nodes.body:
Restructure behind the proven contract
Re-run unchanged behavioral tests
Feature/fix owns behavioral changes

nodes.title: Verified parity
nodes.body:
Restructured code + parity evidence
Commit only through commit-gate

nodes.title: /chore
nodes.body:
Classify docs / deps / revert
Reject behavior smuggled into the lane

nodes.title: docs
nodes.body:
Secrets + diff + user-facing copy checks
No TDD required for prose

nodes.title: deps / existing version bump
nodes.body:
dependency-reviewer; manifest + lockfile
Affected local tests; code adoption redirects

nodes.title: revert / named commit
nodes.body:
git revert <SHA>; affected tests
Reason and SHA in the commit message
Missed defect? Follow with /fix

nodes.title: Reviewed non-behavioral change
nodes.body:
Matching type proof
commit-gate → finishing owner
Exact-head hosted CI before merge
Explicit persistence authority still applies

nodes.title: /add-dep
nodes.body:
Package purpose + identity
Read stack and security policy

nodes.title: Durable adoption / dependency-reviewer
nodes.body:
License • provenance • maintenance • supply chain
Vetting outcome returns to the requesting workflow

nodes.title: One-off branch: pinned tool + registry + confirmation
Vetted decision / tool result
nodes.body:
Ephemeral: verify no manifest/lock change
Adoption: retain reviewed policy outcome

nodes.title: Return to caller
nodes.body:
Feature/fix owns behavior adoption
No automatic PR from a tool run

nodes.title: Five outcomes; no automatic repair or ADR
nodes.body:
Code defect → candidate fix handoff     |     Non-code cause → existing owner
Design question → user decision     |     No action → positive closure evidence
Unresolved → discriminator + next action + resume condition
nodes.detail: The dedicated Debug handoff map expands the five dispositions. Only confirmed_code_defect plus next_step.target fix, validated packet, current evidence and actual caller repair authority can continue to TDD. A design question does not automatically create an ADR; no-action and unresolved do not automatically create tasks.

panels.title: 01  /  INVESTIGATE FIRST WHEN THE CAUSE OR ANSWER IS UNKNOWN
panels.caption: Diagnosis and exploration produce evidence. Neither silently turns into production implementation.

panels.title: 02  /  PROVE THE RIGHT OBLIGATION BEFORE CHANGING CODE
panels.caption: The code-map is optional orientation. Declared commands and applicable governing rules remain required.

panels.title: 03  /  SCALE THE GATES TO NON-BEHAVIORAL WORK
panels.caption: A chore is not a back door for changed behavior.

panels.title: 04  /  DISTINGUISH DEPENDENCY ADOPTION FROM A ONE-OFF TOOL
panels.caption: /add-dep is also a prerequisite branch that returns to the owner that requested it.

notes.text: Common persistence boundary: a verified change is eligible to request commit-gate, not permission to commit, push, merge or release.
Security, migration and dependency scope touches branch to their existing specialist owners; urgency never changes the selected lane’s gates.
